articles.title: Houthi missile threat towards Riyadh causes damage, Saudi-led coalition says
articles.description: Saudi Arabia's air defences dealt with a missile threat launched by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis towards Riyadh, with debris causing material damage in the capital. The incident comes amid escalating cross-border attacks following the collapse of a UN-brokered truce, as fighting intensifies over strategic areas near the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
